burnout.name: Burnout
burnout.line: Work has worn me down so much that I dread every morning.
burnout.why: Keeps the exhaustion of the original and says what it looks like in a day: dreading the start of work.

burnout.name: Burned out
burnout.line: By the end of the workday I have nothing left for my family or myself.
burnout.why: Keeps 'nothing left' from the original and shows where it lands: the hours after work.

bad-job.name: Mistreated at work
bad-job.line: My boss or coworkers treat me badly, and I dread going in.
bad-job.why: Says it the way a person would and names who does it, while staying one issue.

meaningless-work.name: Pointless work
meaningless-work.line: I spend my days on work that doesn't help anyone.
meaningless-work.why: Names the problem rather than the area, so the heading doesn't mix labels, and makes it something you can picture.

wrong-career.name: Wrong career
wrong-career.line: I'm in the wrong line of work, and I don't know how to switch.
wrong-career.why: Names the problem rather than the area, and the second half separates it from work that merely feels pointless.
